title: Keto Donabe Chicken Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy keto bowl made with chicken, donabe, and rice.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Short grain rice, rinsed and drained

instructions: 1. Rinse the donabe and add 1 cup of water to it.
2. Add the rice to the donabe and cook according to the manufacturer's instructions.
3. In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of coconut oil over medium-high heat.
4. Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
5. In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tbsp of coconut oil and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
6. Add the cooked chicken back to the pan and stir in the soy sauce.
7. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
8. To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked rice in the bottom, followed by the chicken and sauce mixture.
9. Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
